scenarios.rule: A specimen advances through versioned states with actor, time, and detail digest.
scenarios.failure_twin: transition outside the released state graph
scenarios.recovery: reload the current revision and follow an allowed transition
scenarios.scientific_effect: reviewers see the current meaning and its history
scenarios.executive_effect: release decisions remain explainable and reconstructable

scenarios.rule: A stable request identity resolves uncertain vendor outcomes before resubmission.
scenarios.failure_twin: same request identity with changed content
scenarios.recovery: authoritative readback or governed reconciliation queue
scenarios.scientific_effect: one canonical revision produces one vendor effect
scenarios.executive_effect: transient failures preserve data quality and operator focus

scenarios.rule: Migration and restore preserve identity, revision, relationships, semantics, audit, and artifact bytes.
scenarios.failure_twin: matching row count with changed scientific content
scenarios.recovery: close cutover, preserve environment, reconcile, and repeat
scenarios.scientific_effect: historical and current records retain their meaning
scenarios.executive_effect: cutover and continuity claims carry witnessed evidence

scenarios.rule: Tenant boundaries, trace redaction, and bounded metrics operate together.
scenarios.failure_twin: cross-tenant request or protected value entering a trace
scenarios.recovery: governed transfer or classified digest replacement
scenarios.scientific_effect: authorized teams retain useful operational context
scenarios.executive_effect: privacy and service health become measurable operating properties
